story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain, from code (not observed): on an overhead plan of a generic Houston operating room the four corner cameras power up. At wall height they light in turn, and on the plan an attendant brings a gurney along the corridor. Camera pulses stamp Patient entry on the plan clock as the gurney crosses the door, Draped on a steel wall record panel as hands lay the drape, and Turnover on the plan as the draped patient leaves and a sheet is laid. A desk phone lights as the next patient arrives, is draped, and the text arrives. The study records play on a desk ledger, ending on a blank turnover box beside a clock and a 25-case result card, then a cut to the room with its lamps lit.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on the plan with the cameras powering up and answers at s7. It closes first on the detail box and result card, then on the room behind a desk ledger whose answer is illegibly small. The causal arc holds, but B's last picture cannot deliver the answer on its own.
story_review.weakest_transition: s10-shot-1 to s10-shot-2 (56.78 s). The cut goes from a readable detail of the box and result card to a wide room where the same answer shrinks into a squashed ledger, so the closing image loses the information the film ends on.
